agentId.description: The agent's id, as list_agents answered it.

text.description: What to tell the agent, as the member's own words: it reads them as a message the member typed in its composer.

queue.description: true to queue it behind the agent's turn, as the composer's ⌘↩ would, rather than steer it into the turn under way: it waits unsent, and goes as the member's next message once the turn and every message queued before it are over, at once where the agent stands idle. Only the agent's starter queues to it.
